item.title: It’s Official, GTA 6’s Graphics Have Broken My Brain
item.description: The first time I played Grand Theft Auto 5 , I was ready to wreak havoc the second I picked up the controller. When my buddy handed me the controller to try it out at his apartment, I asked him how to unlock all weapons and got up to the old tricks of my PS2 glory days. Cars were stolen, cops were exploded, and fun was had by all (except the pedestrians).

item.title: Former Blade Director Reveals What Went Wrong With The Ill-Fated Marvel Movie
item.description: Director Bassam Tariq, who was previously attached to direct the Mahershala Ali Blade movie that never came to fruition, was candid that the lack of a strong, complete script caused the Marvel Cinematic Universe movie to fall apart before it even started shooting.

item.title: How to use auto drive in GTA 6
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 's auto drive feature is perfect if you just want to see the sights of Leonida or avoid navigating through traffic. Not that GTA 6 goes out of its way to tell you there even is an auto drive feature. It's tucked away in a menu you have little cause to use early in the game, and you also need to make sure a specific setting is toggled on for it to work in some circumstances. It's best to still learn how to drive decently yourself, though, as auto drive isn't the best choice in hectic situations.

item.title: Apple TV’s New 8-Part Crime Thriller Is Already a No. 1 Streaming Hit
item.description: Anthony Mackie has spent decades building an impressive Hollywood career, moving between blockbuster franchises, action movies, and acclaimed television projects. From playing Sam Wilson in the Marvel Cinematic Universe to starring in The Hurt Locker and 8 Mile , Mackie has become a familiar face to audiences across several genres.

item.title: Darkest Dungeon 2 DLC's New Mode Is Very Different From The Base Game
item.description: We haven't gotten new DLC for Darkest Dungeon 2 in over a year, but the wait makes sense now that The Butcher's Asylum has been revealed. Launching in 2027, this DLC will add a whole new standalone game mode that remixes how you play this grim roguelike RPG.

item.title: Where to find the bowling alley safe code in GTA 6
item.description: The Kingpin Bowling Alley safe code in Grand Theft Auto 6 is, frustratingly, not actually in the bowling alley itself. No, to get your hands on it legitimately, you need to ransack a different Kolt & Associates illegal operation, which essentially acts as the gang's headquarters, and has multiple safe codes available at once. But that doesn't help when you're deep in the back offices of the bowling alley, and you're being shot at by dozens of angry gang members.

item.title: GTA 6's Impact on Steam and Roblox After Record-Breaking Launch Revealed
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 sold over 32.5 million copies through pre-orders alone and delivered never-before-seen levels of player engagement on both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. But according to a new report, GTA 6's release only caused slight user count declines for Steam and Roblox, rather than massive ones.

item.title: D&D Publisher Officially Hands Record-Breaking AI Settlement Money to Authors
item.description: Anthropic, known for creating the AI platform Claude , was the target of a 2025 class-action lawsuit that resulted in the largest copyright settlement to date. While it was determined that Anthropic could use fairly obtained books to train large language models (LLMs) for Claude, the company resorted to using pirate libraries with thousands of unauthorized copies. This was later deemed an unfair use of authors' copyrighted work. Anthropic agreed to a settlement of $1.5 billion to be distributed among the publishers and authors of approximately half a million books.
